subject.source_delta: Proof-only rational reduction repair with explicit prerequisites. Remove accidental hypothesis at1.2 and misplaced interior tags. Supply rational union/intersection identities with both inclusion proofs, finite and ±infinity cases, countable enumeration padding, separate reductions3–5, and infinity-fibre/all extended-threshold identities. Original Statement/provenance/sources/verification untouched; dependencies add proper A countability and sigma closure.

premise_dispositions: Dense rational embedding gives a rational between finite unequal values and above/below every real by intervals (a,a+1)/(a-1,a); no Archimedean approximation premise is required.

Rationals-countable theorem proves a choice-free enumeration by quotient surjections/Schroder-Bernstein. Padding rational-index subsets with X/empty set turns every displayed operation into an N-indexed sigma operation.
Sigma-algebra Definition supplies complements/unions; closure-law theorem proves intersections by De Morgan, including empty intersections.
Extended real codomain Definition supplies the total order and both infinite endpoints; proof evaluates their membership separately and avoids undefined arithmetic on infinite values.
